plan.completeness_standard: Every category requires explicit authoritative scope and complete effective-date coverage. Empty query, snippet, current reference or single dividend announcement cannot prove absence. All general-update attachments relevant to action mechanics and earlier-announced pending events require review. Dated EQ masters prove symbol/series/ISIN and par-value observations only, not economic-action completeness. Finite lookback alone cannot exclude older pending schemes. Record exact residual gap instead of certifying by silence.
plan.conflict_resolution: Keep originals and superseding records; match issuer, equity class, EQ series, active ISIN and event dates. Legacy action-feed ISINs require original issuer and dated NSE reconciliation. Unresolved conflicts block; do not alter policy.
plan.date_semantics: Separate announcement, board, shareholder, record, ex, appointed, effective and trading dates. Classify on effective trading impact, not announcement or proposed appointed date.
existing_other_findings: ICICIBANK record date 2026-08-03; NSE ex-date unresolved in parent

retrieval_scope.followup_constraint: Only named events or period reconciliation; no July TEST market data

plan.safety: Public metadata only. Zero candles, broker/account reads, orders, WebSockets, DB/token mutations, HALT/arm/execute, real strategy evaluation, commit or push.
source_hierarchy: NSE action and announcement archives, circulars and dated security references
Issuer original filings to NSE/BSE and investor relations
stop_conditions: Frozen baseline, policy, universe or source hash mismatch
Retrieval budget exhausted: freeze bounded findings and unresolved gaps
Source restrictions: log failure and bounded official alternative; no bypass
